d:
The Calcutta High Court has cancelled the appointment of Ritabrata Banerjee as the Leader of the Opposition in the West Bengal Assembly. The court also set aside the appointment of Akhruzzaman as Chief Whip and directed the Assembly Speaker to reconsider both appointments within 10 days, in accordance with the law. The decision comes after senior Trinamool Congress MLA Sovandeb Chattopadhyay challenged the Speaker’s order. Ritabrata Banerjee had emerged as the Leader of the Opposition with the support of rebel TMC MLAs, in a major setback for Mamata Banerjee’s party.
